requirements.quote: streams are flow controlled both individually and across a connection as a whole.
requirements.condition: When an implementation sends or receives stream data on a QUIC connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply flow control independently to each stream and collectively across the connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not limit stream data solely at the per-stream level or solely at the connection-wide level.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation behavior can be tested to confirm that both per-stream and connection-wide flow-control limits constrain stream data.

requirements.quote: A QUIC receiver controls the maximum amount of data the sender can send on a stream as well as across all streams at any time
requirements.condition: When a QUIC receiver advertises or enforces flow-control limits.
requirements.required_behavior: Control both the maximum data permitted on each stream and the maximum data permitted across all streams at any time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the sender to exceed either the applicable per-stream maximum or the aggregate maximum across all streams.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary per-stream and aggregate transmitted data and verify that the receiver maintains and enforces both maxima over the connection state.

requirements.quote: a QUIC endpoint controls the maximum cumulative number of streams that its peer can initiate
requirements.condition: When a peer initiates streams on a QUIC connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Control the maximum cumulative number of streams that the peer is permitted to initiate.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not treat the stream limit merely as a limit on concurrently open streams when doing so permits the cumulative number initiated to exceed the allowed maximum.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be tested by repeatedly opening and closing streams and checking that the initiation allowance is tracked cumulatively.

requirements.quote: Data sent in CRYPTO frames is not flow controlled in the same way as stream data.
requirements.condition: When processing data carried in CRYPTO frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Handle CRYPTO-frame data outside the stream-data flow-control mechanism.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply stream-data flow control to CRYPTO-frame data in the same way as stream data.
requirements.why_checkable: Frame-processing paths and runtime behavior can be inspected to verify that CRYPTO data is not accounted against or gated by stream-data flow-control limits.

requirements.quote: QUIC implementations SHOULD provide an interface for the cryptographic protocol implementation to communicate its buffering limits.
requirements.condition: When a QUIC implementation integrates with a cryptographic protocol implementation that has buffering limits.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an interface through which the cryptographic protocol implementation can communicate its buffering limits.
requirements.why_checkable: The integration API and runtime communication can be inspected or tested for a mechanism that conveys cryptographic buffering limits to QUIC.
